basic_info.description: Located in the heart of Central Richmond, this top floor, corner unit 2 bedroom, 2 bathroom, 1 car parking condo offers modern living in a prime location. Built in 2018, the home features a bright and open layout, a chef's kitchen, air conditioning, and contemporary finishes designed for both comfort and style. The building offers elevator access for convenience, an expansive shared backyard and a courtyard. Just steps from a variety of restaurants, shops and public transportation, this home provides the perfect blend of urban accessibility and residential charm. Don't miss this opportunity to own a beautifully designed home in one of the city's most desirable neighborhoods.
